/*selectBuyerMpSoUniformMonthGrList*/
SELECT X.BUYER, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = X.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, X.BUYER_ITEM_NO, MAX(X.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION, MAX(X.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION, SUM(X.GR_QTY) AS GR_QTY, SUM(X.RE_QTY) AS RE_QTY, SUM(X.GR_QTY - X.RE_QTY) AS TOT_QTY FROM ( SELECT A.BUYER, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, MAX(A.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION, MAX(A.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION, SUM(A.ITEM_QTY) AS GR_QTY, 0 AS RE_QTY, 0 AS TOT_QTY FROM ICOMGRDT A, ICOMCOD2 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.CODE AND A.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND A.ITEM_QTY > 0 AND A.GR_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} || '01' AND #{st_from_date} || '31' AND B.TYPE = 'ST00' AND B.FLAG = 'Y' AND A.BUYER IN (SELECT COMPANY_CODE FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'ST01' AND CODE = #{st_user_id} AND TEXT2 = #{st_com_code} AND FLAG = 'Y')
AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer}
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_description} || '%'
AND A.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_specification} || '%'
GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO
UNION ALL
SELECT A.BUYER, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, MAX(A.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION, MAX(A.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION, 0 AS GR_QTY, SUM(A.ITEM_QTY * -1) AS RE_QTY, 0 AS TOT_QTY FROM ICOMGRDT A, ICOMCOD2 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.CODE AND A.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND A.ITEM_QTY < 0 AND A.GR_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} || '01' AND #{st_from_date} || '31' AND B.TYPE = 'ST00' AND B.FLAG = 'Y' AND A.BUYER IN (SELECT COMPANY_CODE FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'ST01' AND CODE = #{st_user_id} AND TEXT2 = #{st_com_code} AND FLAG = 'Y')
AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer}
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_description} || '%'
AND A.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_specification} || '%'
GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) X WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY X.BUYER, X.BUYER_ITEM_NO ORDER BY X.BUYER, X.BUYER_ITEM_NO
